title: Retention of emergency 911 recordings.
bodyText: Each county public safety answering point shall retain recordings of all emergency 911 telephone calls and radio dispatches for a period of not less than one year.
bodyHtml: [§46-1.7]  Retention of emergency 911 recordings.  Each county public safety answering point shall retain recordings of all emergency 911 telephone calls and radio dispatches for a period of not less than one year. [L 2005, c 192, §1]
